# Security policy

Report against `main`. Fixes land on `main`; older builds are not maintained.

Report vulnerabilities through [GitHub's private advisory form](https://github.com/Koopa0/Kotonoha/security/advisories/new).
If the form is unavailable, wait for private reporting to be enabled; do not
post vulnerability details in a public issue.

Include the app version or commit, device and OS version, reproduction steps,
and expected impact. Use synthetic progress data. Do not attach personal
learning records, credentials, or signing keys.
